cycling_below_min: Not established by exact-model published evidence. The exact system has a published 4.0 kW cooling-range endpoint and staged inverter control, but no below-range cycling threshold, minimum on/off runtime, duty cycle, or compressor ON/OFF behaviour is specified.
fan_speed_configuration: Auto, Low, Medium and High; 4-speed indoor fan control.

indoor_split_piece_dimensions_mm: not applicable; LRE-100CS is not the separable 17 kW chassis
small_zone_behaviour: Optional ActronAir NEXUS zoning is compatible with UltraSlim CS indoor units. Official zoning guidance provides either a constant-zone or bypass design; for LRE-100xx (9-11 kW High-SP) it recommends a 350 mm common-zone duct / bypass damper. No minimum active-zone area or guaranteed compressor behaviour at very small loads is published.
